name: vstack
description: It’s easier to show than explain. Visual Stack is an open-source toolbox for reviewing, polishing and building with your agent, right on the screen, in a browser tab beside Claude Code. Review: you point, Claude fixes. Comment on a wireframe or an app you already have running, and Claude publishes each fix into the same tab, with every comment attached to the element, route, and version it refers to. Polish: a design audit, with before-and-after previews. Claude audits the UI at a Clean, Refined, or Showcase level and shows every proposed fix as a picture beside your screen today. You approve, steer, or reject each one, and nothing in your code changes until you say yes. For a site you can't edit, you get a report to share instead. Wireframes are self-contained HTML and review state stays in your project.
